crossRefs.note: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them…
The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean…
You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of…
but you shall eat them before Yahweh your God in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose: you, your son, your…
At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it…
The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the…
You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of…
Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:

translations.web: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD.
translations.kjv: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD
translations.asv: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy, for giving praise unto Jehovah.
